events.title: China sanctions Paraguay, Belize ministers over Taiwan ties

refs.t: Diplomatic Coercion: Chinese Sanctions On Belize And Paraguay

events.sum: China has imposed sanctions on Paraguayan and Belizean ministers over their support for Taiwan. This action is part of a broader diplomatic stance against countries that recognize Taiwan as part of China.

about.title: Belize
about.extract: Belize is a country on the north-eastern coast of Central America. It is bordered by Mexico to the north, the Caribbean Sea to the east, and Guatemala to the west and south. It also shares a maritime boundary with Honduras to the southeast. Part of the Caribbean region, Belize is a member of the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) and the Commonwealth Caribbean, the historical British West Indies.
